Construct a Block Replication of a Matrix Parameter

Source: R/kron_identity.R
kron_identity.Rd

\(M(\eta) = I_m \otimes S(\eta)\) for an inner matrix parameter \(S\) of dimension \(d\): a block-diagonal matrix of dimension \(md\) whose \(m\) diagonal blocks are the same matrix, sharing one free vector.

Usage

kron_identity(structure, m)

Arguments

structure

An object inheriting from matrix_parameter: the per-block parameter.

m

The number of blocks, a single integer of at least 1.

Value

An object of class KronIdentityParam.

Details

This is the covariance (or precision) of \(m\) independent groups whose within-group structure is common – the shape a grouped random-effect term needs, with \(S\) the per-group matrix over the coefficients of one group. Every quantity of the contract is a linear lift of the inner parameter's: $$\partial_k M = I_m \otimes \partial_k S, \qquad \log\lvert M \rvert_{+} = m \log\lvert S \rvert_{+}, \qquad M^{-1} = I_m \otimes S^{-1},$$ so nothing is rederived, and the rank is \(m\) times the inner rank with the null basis replicated blockwise.

The free names are the inner parameter's own: the blocks share their values by construction, which is what distinguishes this composition from a general block-diagonal of distinct structures.

See also

log_cholesky, diagonal_matrix

Examples

s <- kron_identity(log_cholesky(2), 3)
c(dimension = s@dimension, n_free = s@n_free)
#> dimension    n_free 
#>         6         3 
param_logdet(s, c(0.1, 0, -0.2))
#> [1] 0.6
